slides.eyebrow: 6 years in real estate. Here's what actually happens when you call me:
slides.sub: Finding the home takes 2 to 4 weeks on average in NJ. Step 4 starts a 3-business-day clock.

slides.title: 1. A free consultation
slides.body: We talk about your budget, the towns you want and your commute. You leave with a plan and [[your next step]]. No obligation.

slides.title: 2. Get preapproved
slides.body: I'll connect you with a licensed lender so you know [[what you can afford]] before we tour. Talk to a licensed lender for your numbers.

slides.title: 3. Search, then offer
slides.body: Finding a home in NJ takes [[2 to 4 weeks]] on average. When we find the one, we write the offer in [[24 hours or less]].

slides.title: 4. Attorney review to keys
slides.body: After the signed contract is delivered, attorneys have [[3 business days]] to review it, not counting weekends or legal holidays. Then inspection, appraisal and closing. Talk to a real estate attorney about your situation.

caption:
Here's what actually happens when you call me, from the first call to your keys.

1. A free consultation: budget, towns, commute.
2. Preapproval with a licensed lender.
3. Search and offer. Finding a home in NJ takes 2 to 4 weeks on average, and the offer goes in within 24 hours.
4. Attorney review (3 business days), inspection, appraisal and closing.

Talk to a licensed lender for your numbers.
